meta.name: 网约车运营 NL2SQL 评测集
meta.description: 面向 ride-hailing-analytics-system 的 Text-to-SQL 评测集，用于量化 NL2SQL 准确率（execution accuracy）。所有 gold SQL 均基于真实 schema_sqlite.sql 列名编写，并在可复现种子库上通过校验。
schema_tables: drivers(id, name, phone, city, register_date, driver_level, status)
coupon_types(id, name, face_value, min_order_amount, valid_days, category)
coupons(id, coupon_type_id, driver_id, issued_at, expired_at, status)
orders(id, driver_id, order_amount, coupon_id, discount_amount, final_amount, order_time, pickup_location, dropoff_location, distance_km, status)
notes: orders.status 取值: completed / cancelled / refunded
coupons.status 取值: unused / used / expired
时间列( order_time / issued_at / expired_at / redeemed_at ) 为 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' 文本，可用 SQLite 的 datetime()/strftime() 比较
金额比较与聚合使用 REAL 列 order_amount / face_value 等
城市维度需由 orders JOIN drivers 获取（drivers.city 由 generate_data.py 填充）

expect_legend.scalar: 结果应为单行单列（如 COUNT/SUM/AVG 标量）
expect_legend.multi_row: 结果应为至少一行的多行集合（JOIN/GROUP BY/TopN）

cases.question: 订单总数是多少？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders

cases.question: 所有订单的总金额是多少？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(order_amount), 2) AS total_amount FROM orders

cases.question: 平均订单金额是多少？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(order_amount), 2) AS avg_amount FROM orders

cases.question: 金额最高的那笔订单是多少？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT MAX(order_amount) AS max_amount FROM orders

cases.question: 已完成的订单有多少单？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed'

cases.question: 已退款的订单有多少单？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS refunded_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'refunded'

cases.question: 金额大于 100 元的订单有多少单？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS high_value_orders FROM orders WHERE order_amount > 100

cases.question: 最近 7 天的订单数量是多少？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS recent_orders FROM orders WHERE order_time >= datetime('now', '-7 days')

cases.question: 最近 7 天的订单总金额是多少？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(order_amount), 2) AS week_amount FROM orders WHERE order_time >= datetime('now', '-7 days')

cases.question: 各城市的订单总数分别是多少？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT d.city, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN drivers d ON o.driver_id = d.id GROUP BY d.city ORDER BY order_count DESC

cases.question: 各司机完成的订单数分别是多少（按司机名，取前 10）？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT d.name, COUNT(o.id) AS completed_orders FROM orders o JOIN drivers d ON o.driver_id = d.id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY d.id, d.name ORDER BY completed_orders DESC LIMIT 10

cases.question: 各卡券类型一共发放了多少张？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ct.name, COUNT(c.id) AS issued_count FROM coupon_types ct LEFT JOIN coupons c ON c.coupon_type_id = ct.id GROUP BY ct.id, ct.name ORDER BY issued_count DESC

cases.question: 各卡券类型分别被核销了多少张？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ct.name, COUNT(r.id) AS redeemed_count FROM coupon_types ct LEFT JOIN coupons c ON c.coupon_type_id = ct.id LEFT JOIN redemptions r ON r.coupon_id = c.id GROUP BY ct.id, ct.name

cases.question: 按总订单金额排名，金额最高的前 5 名司机是谁？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT d.name, ROUND(SUM(o.order_amount), 2) AS total_amount FROM orders o JOIN drivers d ON o.driver_id = d.id GROUP BY d.id, d.name ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: 发放数量最多的前 3 种卡券类型是什么？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ct.name, COUNT(c.id) AS issued_count FROM coupon_types ct LEFT JOIN coupons c ON c.coupon_type_id = ct.id GROUP BY ct.id, ct.name ORDER BY issued_count DESC LIMIT 3

cases.question: 各卡券类型的核销率（核销数 / 发放数）分别是多少？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ct.name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_issued, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS total_redeemed, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) * 100, 2) AS redeem_rate FROM coupon_types ct LEFT JOIN coupons c ON c.coupon_type_id = ct.id LEFT JOIN redemptions r ON r.coupon_id = c.id GROUP BY ct.id, ct.name

cases.question: 整体卡券核销率是多少？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) * 100, 2) AS overall_rate FROM coupons c LEFT JOIN redemptions r ON r.coupon_id = c.id

cases.question: 金额高于平均订单金额的订单有多少单？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS above_avg_count FROM orders WHERE order_amount > (SELECT AVG(order_amount) FROM orders)

cases.question: 核销率高于整体平均水平的卡券类型有哪些？
cases.gold_sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) * 100 AS rate FROM coupons c LEFT JOIN redemptions r ON r.coupon_id = c.id) SELECT ct.name, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) * 100, 2) AS rate FROM coupon_types ct LEFT JOIN coupons c ON c.coupon_type_id = ct.id LEFT JOIN redemptions r ON r.coupon_id = c.id GROUP BY ct.id, ct.name HAVING rate > (SELECT rate FROM overall)

cases.question: 各司机等级（新手/普通/资深/金牌/钻石）的司机数量分别是多少？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT driver_level, COUNT(*) AS driver_count FROM drivers GROUP BY driver_level

cases.question: 各司机等级的平均订单金额分别是多少？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT d.driver_level, ROUND(AVG(o.order_amount), 2) AS avg_amount FROM orders o JOIN drivers d ON o.driver_id = d.id GROUP BY d.driver_level

cases.question: 状态为已使用（used）的卡券有多少张？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS used_coupons FROM coupons WHERE status = 'used'
